jarText: To open on a bad day. Only you see it.
cardOffText: Stays in your week and does not go in the card.
cardOnText: On Sunday you choose whether it goes.
cardInvisible: Invisible slips never go in a card.
previewText: If this slip goes in the card, this is the text that shows.
sentNote: This slip already went in a card. The sent card keeps the earlier copy, even if you edit or delete it here.
deleteText: It will be removed from your week and your timeline.
errorText: It is still saved. Try again.

errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment.
errors(map).other: Couldn't do that right now. Try again.
